spec.description:
The chart represents when and why Dynamic Task Batch Sizer changed the task batch size.

Increase reasons (positive values):
- more_tasks means that there are still tasks in the database, so the size should be increased. Spikes of more tasks may be aligned with new deployments of cadence-history due to the batch size being in the middle of the range by default. 

Decrease reasons (negative values):
- error means that there were some errors during the fetching of task replication
- shrunk means that the number of replication messages exceeds the maximum allowed response size
- possible_stuck means that replication is possibly stuck on the passive side
